item.title: City of Madison issues year long pause on data center development

item.title: Black History Month brings unity and celebration to UW
item.description: February marks Black History Month at the University of Wisconsin, a month-long celebration centered on reflection, community and culture. This year’s theme, Black Love: Rooted, Radiant, Revolutionary, celebrates love in all of its forms and honors the power of love in Black communities, according to the Black History Month page on the Student Affairs website....
